citation.title: A High Fiber Cookie Made with Resistant Starch Type 4 Reduces Post-Prandial Glucose and Insulin Responses in Healthy Adults

population.description: 28 healthy adults (14 men, 14 women), age and BMI mean ± SD from Table 2. Inclusion: age 18 or older, BMI 18.0-29.9 kg/m2, fasting glucose <=6.0 mmol/L (enrolment criteria; observed min/max not reported). Some analyses have fewer subjects (Table 3 footnote); the finding n is that of the cell.

protocols.name: control_cookie
protocols.description: Control cookie eaten with 250 mL water after a 12 h fast (Table 1: total carbohydrate 36.84 g, available 36.28 g, fibre 0.55 g, fat 3.99 g, protein 5.36 g); samples 0-120 min

protocols.name: fibre_cookie
protocols.description: Fibre cookie with 25 g VERSAFIBE 1490 RS4, same total carbohydrate as control (Table 1: total 36.84 g, available 12.71 g, fibre 24.13 g, fat 3.92 g, protein 4.92 g), 250 mL water, after a 12 h fast

protocols.name: fasted_sample
protocols.description: Fasting blood sample, before the cookie; arm ends after the sample. Table 2 does not say when it was drawn, in which fast (the visits' 12 h fast is assumed) or the sample type

findings.description: Intravenous blood glucose positive iAUC 0-120 min, control cookie (n=27)

location.where: Table 3, column 'Control Cookie', row iAUC0-120min (mmol/L *·h); only the positive area above the baseline value counts (Methods 2.5)

findings.description: Intravenous blood glucose positive iAUC 0-120 min, fibre cookie (n=25)

location.where: Table 3, column 'Fiber Cookie', row iAUC0-120min (mmol/L *·h); only the positive area above the baseline value counts (Methods 2.5)

findings.description: Intravenous serum insulin positive iAUC 0-120 min, control cookie (n=27)

location.where: Table 3, column 'Control Cookie', row iAUC0-120min (pmol/L *·h); only the positive area above the baseline value counts (Methods 2.5)

findings.description: Intravenous serum insulin positive iAUC 0-120 min, fibre cookie (n=25)

findings.description: Fasting blood glucose of all 28 participants (sample type and visit not stated)

left_out.what: Cmax0-120min of intravenous and capillary glucose and of intravenous insulin, both cookies (Table 3): the rows are labelled with an area unit (mmol/L *·h, pmol/L *·h) that contradicts a peak concentration (Methods 2.5 defines Cmax as the highest concentration)

capillary blood glucose iAUC0-120min, both cookies (Table 3: control 2.35 +/- 0.94, n=26; fibre 1.22 +/- 1.18, n=23): the same people and minutes as the intravenous glucose entered, at a different level (the paper notes the sampling technique changes the absolute values); two targets for one glucose in one arm would contradict each other, so only the intravenous one is entered
percent reductions and p-values between cookies, text of 3.2 and Table 3 (44%, 48%, 46%, 8%, 9%, 23%)
glucose and insulin time courses (Figure 2A-C); only in figures
the fibre in the fibre cookie is an added resistant starch type 4 (distarch phosphate); the model carries its grams only, not the fibre type
